caseName: Miller v. District Court of Iowa ex rel. Lee County
caseNameFull: Miller v. District Court of Iowa in and for Lee County
attorneys: Petitioner pro se. Evan Hult-man, Attorney General of Iowa, for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Iowa denied in light of the representations of the State Attorney General as to the adequacy of state remedies.
